camel_example: aliyun elasticsearch GET /openapi/diagnosis/instances/es-cn-n6w1qu7ei000p0000/reports --region cn-hangzhou --size 20 --startTime 1594569600000 --endTime 1595174399999 --page 1 --detail true --trigger SYSTEM --lang es --header "Content-Type=application/json"
description_en: Retrieves historical reports of intelligent O&M diagnostics
description_zh: 调用ListDiagnoseReport，获取智能运维的历史报告
kebab_example: aliyun elasticsearch list-diagnose-report --instance-id es-cn-n6w1qu7ei000p0000 --lang es --start-time 1594569600000 --end-time 1595174399999 --page 1 --size 20 --detail true --trigger SYSTEM --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDiagnoseReport

parameters.help_en:
The language of the reports to retrieve. Default value: the browser language. Valid values:

- en: English
- zh: Simplified Chinese
- zt: Traditional Chinese
- es: Spanish
- fr: French
parameters.help_zh:
获取的报告的语言。默认为浏览器语言，支持：

- en：英语
- zh：简体中文
- zt：繁体中文
- es：西班牙语
- fr：法语
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The start timestamp of the query. Unit: milliseconds.

- Minimum value: 1000000000000
- Maximum value: 2000000000000
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end timestamp of the query. Unit: milliseconds.
- Minimum value: 1000000000000
- Maximum value: 2000000000000
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The page number. Default value: 1. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 200
parameters.help_zh: 分页数。默认值：1，最小值：1，最大值：200
parameters.name: page

parameters.help_en: The number of reports per page. Default value: 10. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 500
parameters.help_zh: 每页报告数。默认值：10，最小值：1，最大值：500
parameters.name: size

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to display the details of diagnostic items
parameters.name: detail

parameters.help_en:
The trigger method of the health diagnostics. Valid values:

- SYSTEM (default): automatically triggered by the system
- INNER: internally triggered
- USER: manually triggered by the user
parameters.help_zh:
健康诊断的触发方式，支持：

- SYSTEM（默认）：系统自动触发
- INNER：内部触发
- USER：用户手动触发
parameters.name: trigger
